products.name: Frugon
products.business_model: Free, MIT open source (community/reputation play; likely future paid cloud or consulting)
products.core_features: Local proxy captures real LLM logs; analyze which calls a cheaper model handles equally well; token counting + pricing math fully on-machine
products.niche: Teams with runaway LLM API bills
products.design: CLI-first; tagline 'Your LLM bill is leaking.'
products.data_points: HN front page 2026-07-09; MIT license; zero external calls
products.reviews: HN positive on local-first, MIT licensing

products.name: Foreman
products.business_model: Open source self-hosted (likely open-core / enterprise support later)
products.core_features: Single Go binary between agent and providers; policy-based cost-aware routing; prompt-cache-aware model pinning; full spend tracking; keys never leave network
products.audience: Platform/infra engineers running coding agents at scale
products.design: 'Secure and private by default'; deterministic, fast
products.data_points: HN front page same week as Frugon — cost tooling cluster
products.reviews: HN interest in cache-aware routing detail

products.name: Kastor
products.business_model: OSS v0 now; classic Terraform playbook → hosted state/reconciliation as paid product
products.core_features: Typed HCL specs for agents/tools/prompts; LangGraph codegen; plan/apply/state for hosted agents (design stage)
products.audience: Enterprises putting agents into production (a16z: 'every company in 2026')
products.design: Named after beaver (Castor) — builder; 'Terraform for agents' instantly legible positioning
products.reviews: HN: 'works for me. terraform for agents? neat'

products.name: Aura
products.category: Semantic version control for AI coding agents
products.core_features: Hashes AST not lines; records intent ('the Why') in plain English; blocks undocumented AI commits; Amnesia Protocol rewinds broken functions; claims 95% token savings
products.audience: Eng teams drowning in agent-written diffs
products.data_points: PH featured July 2026; claims 95% LLM token cost reduction
products.reviews: PH tagline traction; too new for volume

products.name: Wispr Flow
products.business_model: SaaS $15/mo Pro; enterprise seats; freemium trial
products.core_features: System-wide dictation, auto-edits, command mode, 100+ languages, personal style
products.audience: Writers, devs, execs; 270 Fortune 500 incl. Nvidia & Amazon
products.design: Consumer-grade polish, 'Stop typing, start speaking, 4x faster'
products.data_points: ~$2B valuation talks (~$260M round, Menlo); $81M raised prior; 10x ARR in 5 months; 40% MoM search growth; Trustpilot 2.7/5 vs G2 4.5/5
products.reviews: NEGATIVE cluster: 'works 60% of time after payment'; 800MB RAM idle on Windows; screenshot-to-cloud privacy scandal (CTO apologized); r/macapps: best for beginners, Superwhisper for privacy

products.name: Willow Atlas 1
products.business_model: API + dictation app; human-in-the-loop transcription infra as data moat
products.core_features: Claims 1.2% WER; outperforms ElevenLabs/Deepgram/OpenAI 'by a wide margin'; real-time dictation focus
products.audience: Voice-app developers; dictation users defecting from rivals
products.data_points: Top providers cluster within 1-2pp on LibriSpeech/FLEURS — claim is aggressive; launched on X same week as Wispr's $2B round talk
products.reviews: X launch thread traction; benchmark skepticism expected

products.name: Even Realities G-series
products.core_features: Display-first waveguide HUD, NO camera (privacy bet); Even HAO holistic adaptive optics; prescription-integrated
products.audience: >50% users in US; professionals who won't wear a camera
products.design: Ex-Apple + ex-Lindberg luxury eyewear founders; fashion-first
products.data_points: $150M pre-Series B; $1B valuation; Meituan + Tencent led; markets US/JP/KR/ME/EU (not China)
products.reviews: Press: 'the smart glasses market is splitting in two' (camera vs camera-free)

products.name: Fibermaxxing (consumer trend)
products.source: Google Trends Summergeist / Vitamin Shoppe / CNBC / NPR
products.business_model: Supplements, prebiotic F&B (Simply Pop, Olipop), GLP-1 companion nutrition
products.core_features: Gut health + GLP-1 nutrition + quantified wellness
products.niche: Gut-health maximizers; GLP-1 users needing fiber
products.audience: US mass wellness (70% actively increasing fiber); China XHS gut-health seeders
products.design: '-maxxing' meme suffix converts health advice into a challenge identity
products.data_points: Searches +115% (90d); Vitamin Shoppe fiber sales +20% YTD; psyllium searches +150%; market $4.76B→$7.55B 2033 (6.8% CAGR); Coca-Cola & Nestlé product entries
products.reviews: NPR: benefits 'worth the hype' but experts favor whole foods over supplements
